assumptions.statement: Formal Chengfu Road redline, section and engineering geometry are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No permanent curb, clear-width, capacity or construction dimension is claimed; only continuous relations and reversible modules are designed.

assumptions.statement: Ground-floor entrances, ownership, fire constraints, accessibility and operating rights for Origin and Dongyuan buildings are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Origin foyer work is framed as interface adaptation; Dongyuan and commercial-room proposals remain conditional or deferred.

assumptions.statement: Metro clearances, active rail works and underground high-speed-rail protection conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No rail structure is modified; station tests are surface-level, reversible and removable under a construction scenario.

assumptions.statement: As-built drawings and facility inventory for recent public-realm improvements are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The MVP specifies object relationships and incremental rules rather than claiming new or duplicate construction.

assumptions.statement: No representative real-world public feedback or implemented trial data are available.
assumptions.impact: D0-D40 are digital search generations and R1 is a candidate phenotype, not public consensus or implementation evidence; the Public Feedback Agent may not fabricate interviews.

assumptions.statement: The submitted boundary, evolutionary cells, key-area geometry and resulting ratios are concept-stage competition geometry.
assumptions.impact: They establish reproducible relationships and test the protocol, but must not be read as cadastral, ownership, statutory-control or construction coordinates.
